UserVerification.title: UserVerification
UserVerification.description: Stores Google Sign-In user profile and 6-digit email activation code verification state.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID owning this verification record.

email.description: The user's Google account email address receiving the activation code.

displayName.description: The user's display name from Google Sign-In.

isVerified.description: Whether the user has verified their email activation code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the verification record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the verification record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/user_verifications/{userId}.description: Per-user email activation code and verification status document.
